summary: Algonquin Power & Utilities Corp. (AQN) filed a Form 6-K announcing that its subsidiary Liberty Utilities Co. priced $650M of 5.100% senior unsecured notes due 2031 and $500M of 5.650% senior notes due 2036. Proceeds will repay an AQN intercompany loan (~$690M including interest) and fund a loan to Liberty Utilities (America) Co. to repay amounts owing to AQN. AQN will use funds plus cash on hand to refinance $1.15B of its outstanding 5.365% notes due 2026. Closing is expected May 15, 2026, subject to customary conditions. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation.
